text:
megan: Quick sync 1  final Product Launch blog copy is in the preview. Need quick eyes on hero claim, benchmark phrasing, CTA UTMs, and webinar routing. Aim: publish Mon 9am PT.

ryan: Sending link?

megan: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1729990001  focus on hero + benchmark callout + top CTA.

zoe: Hero idea: 'Predictable inference, engineered for production'  technical but friendly.

priya: Nice. For hero CTA use 'See it in action' to tie to webinar. Bottom CTA keep 'Get started'.

ben: Benchmark wording: avoid absolutes. How about: 'In Dedicated tests, workloads achieved sustained token throughput while maintaining median latency near 100ms on representative prompts.'

ryan: Add a short test config parenthetical: '(test setup: 4xH100, seq_len=256, mixed-batch eval)'.

zoe: Slight tweak: 'median latency typically near 100ms' to soften.

megan: Good. I'll edit to 'median latency typically near 100ms' + parenthetical test note.

ops-bot: UTM suggestion: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=prod_launch_march_2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=prod_launch_march_2026, lead_source=blog, product_interest=dedicated. We recommend server-side tag 'prod_launch_march_2026' for direct CTA clicks.

priya: Ops, please wire server-side tag and ensure webinar form sets 'sales_followup=webinar_attendee'.

ops-bot: Confirmed  will add server-side tag and hidden field mapping.

ben: Legal note from product: avoid competitor comparisons and words like 'always' or 'guarantee'. Also keep numerical claims contextualized.

legal-bot: Quick legal scan: flagged 'production-grade promise' in earlier draft. Replace with 'production-ready' or drop. Add privacy line near webinar form: 'We process personal data according to our Privacy Policy.'

megan: I'll remove 'production-grade' and add the privacy line. Also adding placeholder customer quote block: "Redwood helped us reduce latency and simplify ops"  placeholder.

zoe: Asset ask: I'll update hero banner and create a compact benchmark SVG. Need final copy in 90 minutes.

ryan: SEO micro: include keywords 'dedicated inference' and 'LLM inference latency' in subhead and meta description.

megan: Done. Pushed edits to preview. Tagging @legal-bot for final 20-min pass.

legal-bot: Received  will review in 25.

ben: One tiny UX note: collapse the test-config callout on mobile and include a tooltip on desktop.

priya: Webinar flow: when someone signs up, create HubSpot contact, add tag 'webinar_prod_launch', and trigger Sales Ops alert for leads above 50% usage intent. Ops to confirm thresholds.

ops-bot: Will implement lead tag + Sales Ops webhook. Confirm threshold mapping needed from Priya.

megan: Thanks all  plan: finalize copy after legal pass, ops to wire UTMs and server tag, visuals from Zoe, schedule publish Mon 9am PT. I'll ping here when legal clears. :tada:
